text_block_list.text:
One day, while out for lunch, I come
across King
Halo and her friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I always have the most perfect
lunch!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Which is why you, Sky, must hand over
that last
plate of Kyoto salad!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Are you serious? Just go get a different
salad!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Excuuuuse me?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hey! What's so funny?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, nothing. I'm just kinda happy
things feel
the same as always.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You're here, Sei's here, and we're all
eating
together.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I almost feel like our debut the other
day was just
a dream. But...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. Next year, we'll
all be
doing the Classics together.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Except I'll be the one to take the throne. Hey, Sky, pass me the soy sauce.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Get it yourself.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Ugh! I swear!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh my. Everyone's lively today.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Grass and El!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. It sounded like you all were
having fun,
so I decided to come say
hello.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way about having
debuted. It's
almost surreal.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And now, we're officially competing with
each
other.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe... Winners and losers are both
born at
the sound of the starting gong!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
By the way, I came across some
interesting news!
Take a look at this
article!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... "The Golden Generation
Approaches
Their Classic Year."
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Everyone's names and photos are
here!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And look! King's even got her own
special feature!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: It's the treatment I deserve.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm certain the public is dying to witness
my
ascent to the forefront of our
generation.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Pshhh...
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I wonder what the public would think if
you were
to suddenly "descend"
instead?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: That's funny, because I was wondering what they would think if I made you descend!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Nyahaha! You're scary.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
The Classics... The Triple Crown tour...
The
Japanese Derby too...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Um, hey, King!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yes, Спешл Уик?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Are you planning to run in the Derby?
To become
the best in Japan?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Yes, I am. I must win that G1 race.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh... I see...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Perfect timing!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Do you think you could go a little harder
on me
for today's session?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't call it sudden. I'm just trying
to be the
best Umamusume of my
generation.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm Кинг Хало. I have to win, no matter
who I face.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I need to achieve results worthy of
recognition.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's right. So, if you understand, let's
get sta—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: W-w-wooow! King!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
(If I remember correctly, this is
Kawakami
Princess. Many of the trainers
regard her as quite
the go-getter.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Kawakami. What's the
matter? You
look like you've choked on
a cherry tomato.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Look! Look! There's a special feature
about you!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: O-oh, that's right. There is.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's awesome! The way you talked about
how you
wouldn't give up no matter
what reminds me of
Princess Fighter!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text: Princess Fighter?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oops, I guess you don't know her. She's
the
super-strong main character of this
show that I
really love!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Oh wait, hang on. That's not what I'm
here for.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Ah! I remembered! I wanted to tell you
something!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be rooting for you in the
Classics!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс
Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Well, she blew through like a storm.

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah. That was certainly a new type of

encounter for me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: She seems to really like you, though.

text_block_list.text: I... can't refute that.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But I won't content myself having
gained
only one die-hard fan. I want the
entire world to
recognize my talent.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The real competition is ahead. We must
stay
focused, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
